title: refund-cluster-5 down — refund processor returning errors
description: The refund processor service has been completely down since 18:00 UTC. The service cannot reach refund-cluster-5 which is unresponsive. All refund requests are queued but not processing. Customer-facing refund SLAs are being breached. This is blocking the end-of-day refund batch run.

title: Chargeback API timeout — refund-cluster-5 fault
description: The /api/billing/chargeback endpoint is timing out on all requests. Tracing identifies refund-cluster-5 as the root cause — the cluster is down. The chargeback team cannot process any disputes. Card network deadlines for chargeback responses are at risk. Needs urgent attention.

title: Refund worker crash — refund-cluster-5 cascade
description: Refund worker pods are crashing due to the refund-cluster-5 outage. Workers cannot connect to the cluster to write refund records. Three distinct teams have now reported the same refund-cluster-5 root cause. Platform team confirms this is a shared cluster-level incident.

title: Billing escalation — cluster issue requires immediate action per SOP
description: Per the Billing Incident SOP, when 2 or more tickets report the same cluster failure, all tickets should be escalated with priority=high and category=incident with the incident-core tag. We have at least 2 tickets here about refund-cluster-5. Please escalate using the standard rule: threshold=2+, priority=high, category=incident.

title: Refund audit request — Q1 refund reconciliation
description: The Finance audit team needs a complete refund reconciliation report for Q1. Please pull all refund transactions, disputed amounts, and chargeback outcomes for January through March. This is a routine quarterly compliance task. No urgency — two-week deadline.

title: Billing team training request — new chargeback dispute process
description: The Risk team has updated the chargeback dispute workflow. Please schedule a training session for the billing team covering the new process, the updated Zendesk templates, and the revised response time SLAs. A 90-minute session for 8 people is needed before end of month.
